test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Raghav had a good ______ for stage plays.
solution: The correct answer is: "**troupe**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Troupe **is a group of actors or performers who work together regularly. (अभिनेताओं या कलाकारों का एक समूह जो नियमित रूप से एक साथ काम करते हैं) • It is the most appropriate option to fill the blank, as it fits the context of stage plays. • **Example**: *Raghav joined a troupe of actors to perform in the local theatre production.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. **Complete sentence**: *Raghav had a good troupe __for stage plays.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Trip **refers to a journey or excursion and does not fit the context of stage plays. (एक यात्रा या भ्रमण और मंचीय नाटकों के संदर्भ में फिट नहीं बैठता) • **Trope **refers to a recurring theme or motif in literature or art. (साहित्य या कला में आवर्ती विषय या रूपांकन) • **Troop **refers to a group of soldiers or scouts. (सैनिकों या स्काउट्स का एक समूह) 151:T710, The correct answer is: **We hardly knew nothing**
